description: Easy chocolate chip cookies 🍪👇 Ingredients   1/2 cup unsalted butter (slightly softened)   1/2 cup sugar   3/4 cup brown sugar   1 egg   1 tsp vanilla   1 tsp salt   1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour   1/2 tsp baking soda   Chocolate chips Steps   1. Mix butter, sugar, and brown sugar   2. Add egg + vanilla   3. Mix in flour, salt, baking soda   4. Fold in chocolate chips   5. Scoop onto baking tray   6. Bake at 375°F for 12 min or until edges are golden- take out and rest 15 mins min for crisp  Soft center, crispy edges 🍪   Save so you don’t lose it 👀 #chocolatechipcookies #easyrecipe #foodtok
transcript: Welcome back to Crazy Cookies That Crunch. Sugar white sugar, vanilla extract, salt. Get it to mix in. Gradually add the flour. Baking soda. Yeah, I like to mix it with my hand. Some Cadbury Milk Chocolate, finished product in the oven.
